_why: Accuracy measured on documents the prompts were tuned against is a training-set
number, and reads higher than the pipeline will score on new paper. This file names
which documents are which, so every report has to say which kind of number it is.
Honest caveat, recorded rather than hidden: all eight documents here have already
been run and measured, and the commercial-heading vocabulary in layout.py was written
while looking at ABFL. So 'holdout' below means 'frozen from today', not 'never seen'.
A genuinely clean number needs agreements that have never been through this pipeline;
until then the holdout figure is an upper bound, not an unbiased estimate.
Rule from here on: no prompt, heading pattern or repair rule may be changed in
response to a holdout failure. Diagnose on the tune split, then re-measure.
